# Maqui Comunicaciones

> Written Spanish–English translation of online-shop listings, product descriptions and shop pages, priced per word, from Valparaíso, Chile.

- Translation, per word: $0.12
- Product listing (up to 150 words): $18
- Shop page (up to 600 words): $70
- Rush (48 h), per word: $0.05
- Minimum order: $40

Not offered: sworn document translation, interpreting, languages other than Spanish and English, uploading into shops.
Contact: hola@maquicomunicaciones.com · request form: https://maquicomunicaciones.com/request-a-translation.html
